problems.title: Area from a leg and its opposite angle
problems.question: A right triangle has leg a opposite angle α. Find its area.
problems.idea: Find the other leg using tangent.
steps: The adjacent leg is b=a cotα.

problems.title: Recognize a perfect square
problems.question: Evaluate √(1+2sin30°)√(2+2cos30°).
steps: Since (√3+1)²=4+2√3, its positive square root is √3+1.

problems.title: A tangent subtraction formula
problems.question: Find tanα if tan(135°-α)=1/2.
steps: If cosα=0, the given tangent would be 1, so that omitted case cannot solve it.

problems.title: Exact pentagon angle values
problems.question: Evaluate cos36°cos72°.
problems.idea: Multiply the two exact cosine values.

problems.title: Range of a quadratic in sine
problems.question: For which a does y=a meet y=2sin²x+sinx?
steps: At the endpoints the values are 1 and 3, so the maximum is 3.
Continuity gives every value between the minimum and maximum.

problems.title: Repeated double-angle formulas
problems.question: Simplify sin16α/[(cos²α-sin²α)(2cos²2α-1)(1-2sin²4α)].
problems.idea: Turn the three factors into cosines.
formulas: Denominator=cos2α cos4α cos8α; sin16α=8sin2α cos2α cos4α cos8α.
steps: Cancel the three nonzero denominator factors.
problems.answer: 8sin2α, wherever the original denominator is nonzero.

problems.title: Rotate, then reflect
problems.question: A point in quadrant II is rotated clockwise by 2016°, then reflected in the y-axis. Locate the result.
steps: An initial angle θ∈(90°,180°) becomes θ+144°∈(234°,324°).
After reflection and reduction modulo 360°, its angle lies in (216°,306°).
Thus it lies in quadrant III or IV, with the negative y-axis also possible.
problems.answer: Quadrant III or IV, or the negative y-axis.
problems.note: For an initial angle 126°, the result is exactly on an axis. The printed quadrant choice omits that possibility.

problems.title: Radian values and their signs
problems.question: Order sin10,cos10,tan10 increasingly, with 10 in radians.

problems.title: Check the printed choices against the exact value
problems.question: Evaluate tan105°-2cos330°.
problems.note: None of the printed choices equals this value; in particular -2+√3 has the wrong sign and magnitude.

problems.title: Distance above a triangle’s incenter
problems.question: A point S is 10 cm from each side of a right triangle with legs 18,24. Find its distance to the triangle’s plane.
problems.idea: Project S to an equidistant centre in the plane.
steps: The incenter is 6 cm from every side. The exradii are 12,18,36, all exceeding 10, so they cannot be the projected point.

problems.title: Parallel lines reduce to a triangle cross-section
problems.question: Three parallel lines a,b,c have pairwise distances ab=13,ac=15,bc=14. Find the distance from a to the plane through b,c.
problems.idea: Intersect with a plane perpendicular to all three lines.
steps: The section triangle has semiperimeter 21 and area √(21·8·6·7)=84.
Its altitude to the side 14 is 168/14=12.
This is also the required line-to-plane distance.

problems.title: Relate three spatial angles
problems.question: ABC is right at C, and BD is perpendicular to plane ABC. Given DAB=α,BAC=γ,DAC=β, find the necessary cosine relation.
problems.idea: Use the side ratios of the right triangles.
steps: Multiply the first two ratios: cosαcosγ=AC/AD.
problems.answer: cosβ=cosαcosγ; none of the preceding printed relations.
problems.note: The correct relation is absent from choices a-e, so the “none” choice is required.

problems.title: Two oblique segments share a perpendicular height
problems.question: Two segments from a point to a plane have projected lengths 1 and 4; one segment is twice the other. Find the perpendicular height.
problems.idea: The longer projection belongs to the longer segment.

problems.title: Period depends on the coefficient of x
problems.question: Find the least positive period of y=3sin(3πx+90°)-2π.
problems.idea: Read the phase 90° as π/2 radians.
steps: The amplitude and vertical shift do not affect the period.
problems.note: The source mixes radians and degrees in one phase; converting 90° to π/2 gives the usual intended interpretation.

problems.title: Use the quadrant after solving for sine
problems.question: 6sin²x+sinx=1 and π<x<3π/2. Find cotx.
steps: The roots are 1/3 and -1/2. Quadrant III requires s=-1/2.

problems.title: A fourth-power identity
problems.question: Evaluate (1-cos⁴a-sin⁴a)/cos⁴a if tana=0.2.

problems.title: Maximum of a symmetric sine product
problems.question: Find the greatest value of sin(45°-a)sin(45°+a).
steps: The product becomes cos2a/2 because cos90°=0.
Since cos2a≤1, the maximum is 1/2, attained at a=180°k.

problems.title: Possible region counts from three planes
problems.question: Which listed count 2,5,6,3,7,4 cannot be the number of spatial regions made by at most three planes?
formulas: One plane gives 2; two give 3 if parallel or 4 if intersecting.
steps: With three distinct planes: all parallel give 4; two parallel cut by a third give 6.
Three nonparallel planes give 6 when they share a line, 7 when their pairwise intersection lines are parallel and distinct, or 8 when they meet at one point.
Coincident planes reduce to the earlier cases. None gives 5.

problems.title: Reduce each angle to a quadrant
problems.question: How many of cos210°,sin320°,tan467°,cot199°,cos2016° are negative?
problems.idea: Use sign rules after reducing angles.
steps: cot199° is positive in quadrant III.

problems.title: A negative trigonometric product in a triangle
problems.question: Triangle angles A,B,C satisfy sinA tanB cosC<0. What type of triangle is it?
formulas: tanB<0 iff B>90°; cosC<0 iff C>90°.
steps: For the product to be negative exactly one of B,C must be obtuse.
They cannot both be obtuse in a triangle.

problems.title: Projection increases this angle
problems.question: Two equal segments from a point outside a plane meet at 60°. Which listed angle 15°,25°,35°,45°,55°,65° can their projections make?
steps: The right side is strictly less than 1/2, so θ>60°.
Every θ between 60° and 180° can be obtained with a suitable positive height and projection length.
Of the listed values only 65° qualifies.

problems.title: A reciprocal after a cosine
problems.question: f(x)=1/x,g(x)=cos(7πx/8). Find f(g(6)).

problems.title: Equal spatial distances to an equilateral triangle
problems.question: A point is 2a from every vertex and √3a from every side of an equilateral triangle. Find its height above the triangle’s plane.
problems.idea: Its projection is the common circumcenter and incenter.

problems.title: A skew-line distance from a base altitude
problems.question: In a rectangular box AB=1,AD=2. Find the distance between AA₁ and DB₁.
problems.idea: Their common perpendicular projects to the altitude from A to BD in the base.
steps: The diagonal’s horizontal projection is BD. A horizontal line perpendicular to BD is also perpendicular to DB₁ and AA₁.

problems.title: Eliminate the rectangle sides
problems.question: BK is perpendicular to rectangle ABCD at B. Given AK=6,DK=8,CK=7, find BK.
steps: Adding the first two and subtracting the third leaves h².
